title: Create src/tui/components/BlockedScreen.tsx
description: Create the Ink component shown when the AI outputs a <blocked> tag. Displays the blocked reason and instructions for the user to fix the issue and restart the loop.
acceptanceCriteria: BlockedScreen renders a red 'Loop Blocked' header
The blocked reason text is displayed
Instructions 'Fix the issue and run rocket loop again' are shown

steps.details: Create the file. Import React, Box, Text, useInput, useApp from ink.
const { exit } = useApp(); useInput(() => { exit() }). This exits the Ink app on any keypress.

Return: <Box flexDirection='column' marginTop={1}><Text bold color='red'>⛔ Loop Blocked</Text><Text marginTop={1}>{reason}</Text><Text marginTop={1} dimColor>Fix the issue and run rocket loop again. Press any key to exit.</Text></Box>

technicalNotes: useApp() from ink provides the exit() function to terminate the Ink render cleanly
